description: tangent-hole's hole moved out through the side face by a tolerance and a half (1.5e-7), or turned about the contact's middle so its ends move a quarter of a tolerance, or one, through the face and back. Arris fails: a piece with no interior point at its clearance (Fault::Split, NoInterior; the offset), the face's plane and the hole's wall a hair off tangent with no closed form (OpError::Unsupported; the quarter turn) and a section edge ending at a node nothing else reaches (Fault::Split, Dangling; the turn by one). The desired result is the tangent contact's refusal by name, as at the contact: the hole's wall and the face are within a tolerance or two of each other along the whole stretch. Open CASCADE builds a shell of odd Euler characteristic at every variant, as for tangent-hole (plans/c3-tolerance-apart step 1, the band survey)
